articles.title: Synology NAS Devices Targeted in Ransomware Attacks Exploiting Patched DSM Flaw
articles.summary: Synology is urging customers to update the DiskStation Manager (DSM) software powering its Network Attached Storage (NAS) devices following ransomware attacks.
